say:1:1330120001:0.text: It's nice to have a bit of excitement like this once a year.
say:1:1330120001:0.source_cn: 一年能热闹这么一下还是挺不错的。
say:1:1330120001:0.male: It's nice to have a bit of excitement like this once a year.
say:1:1330120001:0.female: It's nice to have a bit of excitement like this once a year.

say:2:1330120002:0.text: As the caretaker of this cemetery, I can use a break from my humdrum routine every now and then.
say:2:1330120002:0.source_cn: 作为巡墓人，偶尔的热闹对我来说是一种不错的调剂。
say:2:1330120002:0.male: As the caretaker of this cemetery, I can use a break from my humdrum routine every now and then.
say:2:1330120002:0.female: As the caretaker of this cemetery, I can use a break from my humdrum routine every now and then.

say:3:1330120003:0.text: It's just that my memory's been getting worse lately, and I feel like I've forgotten a lot from this year's festival...
say:3:1330120003:0.source_cn: 就是我现在记忆力不太好了，总觉得今年祭典上我忘了很多东西……
